name: Green hydrogen in refineries
principle: A PEM electrolyser on renewable electricity supplies hydrogen to refinery hydroprocessing in place of some steam-reformer hydrogen. Shell's REFHYNE at its Rheinland site is a 10 MW PEM unit built by ITM Power, producing up to 1,300 t/yr, with expansion to 100 MW planned.

suppliers.product: 10 MW PEM electrolyser for Shell Rheinland

performance.basis: 10 MW PEM; plans for 100 MW at Rheinland

source.note: Hydrocarbon Engineering, Shell starts up PEM green hydrogen electrolyser in Europe, 5 July 2021
